callbacks_and_context.lifetime: All capabilities and private entries are invocation-scoped. Save neither closures nor paths nor context for reuse. Root readers and writers enforce different retirement guards; returned model closures and ordinary readers do not universally check retirement. Prohibited reuse is an author contract, not a claim of host sandboxing.

runner.params: copied effective admitted parameter object; defaults and bindings already resolved; caller modifications create no authority
runner.normal_return: invisible(list(status='ok')); arbitrary result fields do not retain parameters
runner.retention: retained_parameters names allowed sources explicitly; engine independently retains observed chunking

context.name: network_policy
context.meaning: declared engine policy; trusted code is not a network sandbox

context.name: typed_slice_reads
context.meaning: empty if undeclared; read schedule evidence

context.name: typed_space_reads
context.meaning: empty if undeclared; scoped ordered space read schedule

context.name: input_ids
context.shape: input-name list; matrix/space IDs or null

context.name: derived_cell_output_axis_grants
context.meaning: copied evidence; no grant fabrication or mutation

context.name: standalone_sparse_cell_family_grants
context.meaning: declare admitted keys/rows before linked family write

context.name: sealed_relation_family_grants
context.meaning: declare admitted relation layout before write

callbacks_and_context.context_mutability: All fields are read-only evidence by contract. Modifying a copied field cannot change authenticated core grant state.

name_resolution.G4_G5_G6: named global callbacks with collection/group/ordinal arguments
name_resolution.writers: fixed writer method plus output declaration name

callbacks_and_context.writer_acknowledgment: Opaque name/allocated_id/grant_identity acknowledgment; never construct a receipt from it.

model_handles.reader: read_bytes(relative), path(relative) for ordinary contained models or runtime_private_path(relative) for self-linked models; admitted fitted_source_space/fitted_cells/fitted_features/latent_dimension_count/model_source_linkage/source_space_id may be present
model_handles.writer: open_model_tree(output) once; path(relative), write_bytes(relative,bytes), finish(value,semantic_metadata=list()) once
model_handles.containment: Declared relative entries only, no traversal/symlinks; private staging paths are lawful scoped capabilities, never durable bundle paths
model_handles.trust: A verified checksum does not make RDS or pickle safe; deserialize only trusted models

declaration_callbacks.timing: exactly once before any linked family writer
exactly once before linked model/space/family writes
exactly once before linked sparse-family write
exactly once before linked relation-family write

callbacks_and_context.declarations: Runtime family, derived fitted axis, sparse family and sealed relation writers declare before linked writes; G7 uses a returned derived_cell_output_axis_declarations channel. G3 returns two independent attestations and must finish its bound G2 model tree without changing admitted bytes.
callbacks_and_context.errors: Core rejects undeclared callbacks, wrong writer/profile, stale sources, missing/repeated reads, bad axes, open handles, missing terminals and incomplete closures. Pack errors abort publication; SDK fault helpers restore all hooks on exit. Scientific meaning, finite-value policy and algorithm memory remain author responsibilities.

status_meaning.accepted: Applicable lawful tuples are admitted; not a scientific qualification
status_meaning.schema_parity_only: Shared shape may validate but corresponding runtime authority is absent
status_meaning.implemented: Actual callback and observation closure exist and cited test executes them
status_meaning.unsupported: No scaffold option; parity is not execution support

ordinary_io.reader: readers[input_name]() -> private primitive copy; ordinary matrix also features=None,cells=None
